name: To Serve Gnome
description: A poorly handwritten pamphlet covered in dried blood. But from what?
readText:
How to Serve Gnome

WARNING: The words in this volume are SURE to offend. They're not for the faint of heart. In fact, the author has been run out of MANY CITIES simply for expressing his views on the culinary. If you're not a cocktail weenie, keep your eyes glued to this page. Otherwise, pass this pamphlet on to someone who is less cowardly than you.

Gnome is one of the most delectable meats available. The little buggers are hard to catch, but once you do, you're in for an evening of delicious culinary delight. Heed not their screams; they are not intelligent creatures. They only mimic the sounds of human beings as a defense mechanism. Do not feel guilty for their cries. Tell me, reader, do you feel sadness when a lamb bleats for its mother?

Process gnome like you would any other meat, for they are just like any other meat, only with a more savory, melt-in-your-mouth flavor.

Gnome on a Stick
The most basic way to serve gnome. If you aren't patient enough to butcher it yourself, you can quickly throw the gnome meat onto a skewer, salt it, and cook it over a fire. Very simple, though not as tender.

Gnome Steak
Gnome makes delicious steak just as a steer would. Chop the meat into steaks, salt it, and sear it to desired doneness.

Gnome Pita
Flatbread and gnomes go together like pixie butter and jelly. Take some minced gnome, add chopped garlic and salt, cook until fragrant, and scoop it into some pita bread.

I hope you, too, will be able to enjoy serving gnome as I have.

Whatever they encountered swiftly dispatched an entire company of what, based on the weapons and armor already found, appear to be quite capable combatants.

description: Twin sheep skulls hammered from beaten brass, their hollow eyes staring defiantly into every battle.

name: Gilded Spellbook
description: A high-quality spellbook gilded with gold thread.

name: Wild Carrots
description: This is a modest meal.

name: The Backup Plan
description: A hefty two-handed maul slung over the shoulder, its scarred head serving as a trusted reminder that when all else fails, a backup plan never does.

name: Driftwood Crown
description: A twisted crown of dried wood.

name: Paua Shell Earring
effect: Enduring Breath (On Click. Must Equip. Cast Time: Instant. Level: 1)
description: An iridescent seashell infused with mana.

name: The Final Word
effect: Mana Burn II (Chance On Hit. Level: 30)
description: A massive greatsword forged from both bronze and copper, whose slow, crushing arc ends every argument with each cleaving stroke.

name: Vale Giant Tunic
description: A large-sized sand-pelted tunic from an archer of the Vale.

name: Bloodfang Scale Shield
description: A single, great red scale from Bloodfang herself, used as a shield. Its surface still carries a faint, primal heat.

name: Eye of Serpents
description: A crimson eye-stone wrapped in woven leather forms this fetish, its surface catching the light as though something inside still stirs.

name: Fang of the Serpent
description: A wickedly curved fang reforged into a scimitar, still humming with the serpent's lingering malice.

name: Kennel Master's Faceguard
description: A dusty burlap face covering inscribed with odd runes and symbols.

name: Leather Bracer of Obedience
description: A dusty leather bracer that feels incredibly sturdy despite its scratched and bitten appearance. Vile symbols are imprinted into the leather.

name: Ancient Zintari Seal
description: Bears the mark of the king.

name: Gaze of Empire
description: The commanding visage of a long-dead emperor.

name: Grand Vizier's Coif
description: The iron rings are gilded with gold.

name: Branded Platinum Wristguard
description: A heavy bangle forged in an ancient kingdom.

name: Hammer of Elemental Forging
description: Sularfaan's massive hammer, capable of withstanding the hardest blows and hottest flames.

name: Embezzler's Golden Kilt
description: A kilt made from fabric with a distracting metallic sheen.

name: Wayfarer's Vambraces
description: Once worn by a traveler who sought refuge from the desert heat.

name: Artspatter Footwraps
description: The blood spattered footwraps of a special kind of painter...

name: Chain Splitting Axe
effect: Stun (Chance On Hit. Level: 25)
description: It feels liberating in your hands...

name: Claws of Bonding
description: Claws ripped from the hands of a ferocious beast.

name: Ashira Protector Axe
effect: Strength of the Protector (Chance On Hit. Level: 1)

name: Shield of the Protector
effect: Woodskin (On Click. Any Slot. Cast Time: 10s. Level: 1)

name: Alchemist Bag
description: A medium-sized bag of alchemy supplies.

name: Messy Voodoo Doll
description: A poorly sewn voodoo doll that looks like it has seen better days.

name: Ring of Water
description: Immaculate water from a Font of Life shimmers within the ring.

name: Scented Ceremonial Spear
description: An herb-scented spear used by the ashira for ceremonies.

name: Hip Quiver
description: An efficient hip quiver designed for swift drawing.

name: Serrated Longbow
description: A ranged weapon used to shoot arrows.

name: Huntress's Bow
description: A ranged weapon used to shoot arrows.

name: Soaked Copper Bracer
description: An otherwise nondescript copper bracer that smells strongly of alcohol.

name: Echo Stone
effect: Lightstone (Passive. Must Equip. Level: 1)
description: A dimly glowing stone that echoes to ambient sounds.

name: Gilded Claw of the Gladiator
description: A finely crafted claw with golden trims. Obtained through your mastery of the arena.

name: Gilded Claw Cloak
description: A gaudy cloak worn by members of the Gilded Claws.

name: Pasha's Favor
note: A joint drop from the combined Pasha Patrice/Aide Aida encounter on mnmdrops.com, not from either mob individually.

name: Battleforged Plate Belt
description: A thick metal belt etched with the scars of countless skirmishes.

name: The Impaler
description: The trident of a fallen Red Mantles guard.

name: Hallowed Bone Amulet
description: An old pendant on a golden chain, bearing the likeness of Relle.

name: Fine Black Robe
description: A finely woven black robe.

name: Sanguine Bat Tooth
effect: Life Drain (Chance On Hit. Level: 1)

name: Fire Emerald Pendant
description: An old golden chain with a fire emerald.

name: Ba'Haara Lute
description: A traditional Ba'Haara lute.

name: Barnacle Bracer
description: An old leather bracer encrusted with barnacles.

name: Coral Trident
description: A trident wrought from the coral of the Twilight Sea; it is both beautiful and dangerous.

name: Tidebreaker Cane
description: A driftbone cane, meant to be raised against the tide, not to part it, but to claim it. Etched with elemental glyphs, it carries the authority of a settler who bent the sea's edge to his will.

name: Saltlash
description: "Sharp as sea spray and stings like betrayal." - Cossa

name: Wavebreaker Amulet
description: The amulet of an experienced seadog.

name: Horn of the Sea
description: A coral horn inscribed with strange swirling patterns.

name: Sea Giant's Handkerchief
description: A massive handkerchief with a faint smell of sea salt.

name: Ghostly Longbow
description: A bow once used by Captain Selam.

name: Torque of the False God
description: A gaudy neck ornament.

name: Vile Bastard Sword
effect: Mana Drain III (Chance On Hit. Level: 40)
description: A long blade bestowed upon disciples of the shadow realm.

name: Bracer of the Herald
description: A dark bracer, shimmering with power of storms.

name: Sandals of the Elements
description: Sandals humming with the power of the elements.

name: Ceremonial Greaves
description: Greaves worn during rites of ascension within Muurtu's inner sanctum.

name: Darklight Reliquary
description: A reliquary carved from obsidian glass and veined with pale crystal. It pulses with a rhythm not quite arcane, not quite divine. An artifact born of contradiction.

name: Faithpiercer
description: A blade used to test the faith of the fallen. It cuts through lies as easily as flesh.

name: Girdle of Stern Mercy
description: A plate girdle worn by High-Sister Sarinius during the trials of the penitent. Its surface is etched with faded scripture and blood-bound seals. It tightens not with buckles, but with the conviction of its wearer.

name: Elemental Vest
description: A fine vest infused with primal energies.

name: Mawtooth
description: A serrated tooth pulled from the skull of a killer shark and repurposed as a deadly weapon.

name: Seal of Elements
description: A ring imbued by the elements.

name: Fine Elven Drum
description: A small elven hand drum made of taut leather on a rare wooden frame.

name: Fine Elven Flute
description: A simple well-crafted wood flute.

name: Hangman's Cowl
description: "The devil presides."

name: Searing Dagger
description: A stylish elven dagger.

name: Deathmask of the Witchlord
description: A frightening mask carved from lacquered bone and sealed with ashglass. Those who don it find that their thoughts are no longer entirely their own.

name: Ring of Withering Thought
description: A tarnished band that pulses with forgotten whispers.

name: Skull of Whispers
description: An obsidian-lacquered skull unearthed from the catacombs beneath Muurtu's forgotten sanctum. Faint whispers escape from it, carrying echoes of dark incantations once lost to time.

name: Dented Black Enamel Helm
description: A bronze helm covered in a shiny black enamel coating

name: Reinforced Boiled Leather Buckler
description: A well-crafted boiled leather buckler.

name: Brood Dagger
effect: Whirling Shadows (On Click. Must Equip. Cast Time: 12s. Level: 50)
description: A misshapen blade of blackened steel.

name: Sticky Linen Gloves
description: Gloves coated in spidersilk threads and a tacky residue.

name: Twisted Cord
description: A coarse hemp rope tied with a simple knot.

name: Obsidian Crystal Staff
description: A staff of sleek blackened crystal that is warm to the touch. A faint pulse beats softly beneath your fingers.

name: Robe of the Veiled Doctrine
description: A thickly woven black robe. Its threads swallow the light as if guarding forbidden knowledge.

name: Shard of Obscured Insight
description: A sliver of blackened crystal harvested from the fallen citadel, its surface clouded and lackluster.

name: Amulet of the Accord
description: A polished amulet that distracts just enough to soften objections.

name: Emissary's Veil of Persuasion
description: A veil infused with faint enchantments that lend its wearer influence in any negotiation.

name: Cursed Radiant Blade
effect: Reprisal (Chance On Hit. Level: 50)

name: Guillome's Cracked Skull
effect: Runeskin III (On Click. Any Slot. Cast Time: Instant. Level: 50)

name: Coil of the Slithering
description: You feel as though it is in motion when your eyes are not upon it...

name: High Wyrmseer's Signet
description: A polished signet etched with draconic lines.

name: Fell Trident
effect: Infirmity (Chance On Hit. Level: 50)

name: Black Feathered Bracelet
description: A finely woven bracelet made of leather and raven feathers.

name: Salt-Cured Cloak
description: A cloak, heavily infused with salt dust. Its detailed embroidery reflects Sojourner mysticism.

name: Vest of the Glass Viper
effect: Charisma (Passive. Must Equip. Level: -1)

name: Gelatinous Crown
description: A gooey crown dripping with black ooze.

name: Protean Mantle
description: A mantle woven from fine spider silk.

name: Rod of Consumption
effect: Tainted Fumes (On Click. Must Equip. Cast Time: 12s. Level: 50)
description: A staff made of dessicated flesh.

name: Girault's Bulwark
description: A barely refined slab of iron.

name: Oversized Chain Hauberk
description: A long ringmail coat caked in soot.

name: Wyrmsbane Signal Torch
effect: Torch (Passive. Must Equip. Level: 1)
description: A signal torch bearing a faded Wyrmsbane insignia.

name: Seneschal's Tunic
description: A tunic with coarse fabric that smells of ash.

name: Steward's Silk Slippers
description: A well-worn pair of slippers that offer little comfort or protection.

name: Cloak of the Chiropteran
description: An azure bat-skin cloak that settles around the body like a shadow ready to take flight.

name: Shattershriek Spike
description: A crystallized razor quill plucked from Shattershriek's spine that, when blown into, creates a shrill, haunting shriek.

name: Wings of the Flittermouse
description: Leather shoulder pieces shaped from Shattershriek's wings, each crease suggesting wings about to spread.

name: Wand of Cinder
effect: Inferno (On Click. Must Equip. Cast Time: Instant. Level: 50)

name: Sangrel Rite II
description: A page of the Sangrel Rite.

name: Bonefire Bracer

name: Emberbone Ring

name: Leprotic Gloves

name: House Captain's Ring

name: Ring of Regret

name: Helm of the Last Roar

name: Thrym Cleaver

name: Warrenmother's Rod

name: Faylan's Gambeson

name: Squire's Rondel

name: Handmaiden's Robe

name: Mourning Mantilla

name: Silver Comb of House Torvald
description: A silver comb embedded with the sigil of House Torvald.

name: Ivor's Blood Bracer

name: Cutpurse's Stud

name: Dented Black Iron Girdle

name: Humble Note
description: An unassuming note on simple parchment.
readText:
Dear Ciszil,

You are invited to come train at the School of the Fourfold Path.

An affinity with the elemental arts, if left unharnessed, can pose a danger to yourself and others; but if properly cultivated, it can teach you a great respect for the world around you and bring great power.

Bring this note to Master Tenebrim Tam, and he will ensure that you experience the latter.

The school is directly south of Saltbreeze Park, overlooking Twilight Harbor. If you see elementals floating about, you'll know you're close.

"Achieve balance! Embrace the elements!"
